title: Modeling uncertainty in neural networks with TensorFlow Probability: Part 4: Going fully probabilistic
summary: This tutorial demonstrates how to model both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty in neural networks using TensorFlow Probability by combining variational layers and distribution layers. The paper walks through a hands-on example of building a probabilistic model for non-linear heteroscedastic data using variational inference techniques with prior and posterior distributions.
